scope: Source-aware queue for active organizations/faith in the campaign world and the prepared first-region adventure graph. Six semantic icon originals; church and deity references sharing the same 5e symbol share one original. Research only: no image generation or manifest changes.

basis: src/campaign/world.ts#FACTION and seedWorld: three region factions plus Church of Lathander and Church of Helm are active modeled entities.
src/campaign/party.ts#ALDRIC: owner-selected deity Lathander for the seed party.

research/content-phandelver/first-vertical.json#redbrand-thread: Redbrands are a named first-region thread with source evidence; included as sixth distinct mark, not asserted to be live in the current seed.
selection.deduplication: Church of Lathander and deity Lathander map to one image; Church of Helm and deity Helm map to one image. No separate church marks.

assets.label: Harpers
assets.activeEvidence: src/campaign/world.ts#FACTION.harpers; seedWorld creates fac-harpers with renown 5. Local organization row is content/world/organizations.json#harpers.

sourceExcerpt.text: Silver harp and crescent moon over black or royal blue
sourceRefs: The Code of the Harpers, pp. 3–6, 12–13

officialSources.excerpt: This clandestine network of spellcasters and spies seeks to tip the scales in favor of the innocent, the weak, and the poor within the Realms.

officialSources.note: Official Basic Rules faction emblem image; use as visual source reference, not as a file to copy into the project.

assets.visualBrief: Single transparent, compact silver harp with crescent moon; use the official 5e faction emblem as the reference. No background shield, text, or invented faction variant.

assets.label: Zhentarim / Black Network
assets.activeEvidence: src/campaign/world.ts#FACTION.zhentarim; seedWorld creates fac-zhentarim (goal: influence on Triboar Trail). Local row: content/world/organizations.json#zhentarim.

sourceExcerpt.text: Silhouette of a winged snake biting a coin
sourceExcerpt.note: The same field lists two other historical variants; this queue deliberately selects only the winged snake motif.

officialSources.excerpt: The Zhentarim, or Black Network, is an organization of well-trained mercenaries, savvy rogues, and crafty warlocks.

officialSources.note: Official Basic Rules faction emblem image; visual source reference.

assets.visualBrief: One black winged snake, compact and legible, following the official 5e faction image. Do not add the coin from a separately versioned local variant unless the chosen official image clearly supports it.

assets.label: Lords' Alliance
assets.activeEvidence: src/campaign/world.ts#FACTION.lordsAlliance; seedWorld creates fac-lords-alliance with renown 12. Local row: content/world/organizations.json#lords-alliance.

sourceExcerpt.text: The local organization record has no symbol field; do not infer a canonical device from its name.

officialSources.excerpt: The Lords’ Alliance is an association of rulers from cities and towns across Faerûn (primarily in the North).

officialSources.note: Official Basic Rules faction emblem image; use as visual source reference.

assets.visualBrief: Create one transparent icon following the official Basic Rules Lords' Alliance emblem reference. Preserve its identifying silhouette; no newly invented house crest, lettering, or city-specific seal.

assets.label: Lathander / Church of Lathander
assets.activeEvidence: src/campaign/party.ts#ALDRIC.deity selects Lathander (owner decision noted 28.10.2026); src/campaign/world.ts#FACTION.churchOfLathander creates the church faction. Local organization row: content/world/organizations.json#church-of-lathander.

officialSources.excerpt: Lathander, god of birth and renewal — Symbol: Road traveling into a sunrise.

assets.visualBrief: One small road leading toward a rising sun, using the official 5e deity mark. Reuse this exact original for Lathander and his church; no second church badge or invented rays/holy text.

assets.label: Helm / Church of Helm
assets.activeEvidence: src/campaign/world.ts comments identify Helm as the deity of Neverwinter; seedWorld creates fac-church-of-helm. Local organization row: content/world/organizations.json#church-of-helm.

sourceExcerpt.text: An upright left gauntlet with a staring eye on it

officialSources.excerpt: Helm, god of protection — Symbol: Staring eye on upright left gauntlet.

assets.visualBrief: An upright left gauntlet bearing one staring eye, following the official 5e deity mark. Reuse the same original for Helm's church; no separate generic eye or alternate-hand version.

assets.label: Redbrands / Redbrand Ruffians
assets.activeEvidence: The local campaign world does not currently model a Redbrands faction; the named group and thread are in research/content-phandelver/first-vertical.json#redbrands and #redbrand-thread (book evidence pp. 14, 18–21). Queue as a first-region extension only.

sourceExcerpt.note: The catalog also records Lost Mine of Phandelver pp. 19, 21 for the creature node; the organization record content/world/organizations.json#redbrands has no symbol field.

officialSources.note: Official source table of contents confirms the faction in the adventure; local page citations remain the exact source for this seed graph.
